annotations.title: Preflight: ask before acting on a domain

description: Call BEFORE reading, citing, connecting to or transacting with a domain. Returns a signed decision: allow, warn, require_confirmation, block or unsupported, with every step that led there and the resolve answer it was made from. Pass your crawler token as agent so robots.txt is checked for you. A policy can only make the decision stricter. A block decision means the action is not permitted; require_confirmation means a human must confirm before it proceeds.

action.description: What you are about to do (default read)

agent.description: Your crawler user-agent token, e.g. GPTBot

policy.description: max_age_hours, on_warn (warn|require_confirmation|block), require_entity, human_approval[], allow[], deny[]

template.description: safe_citation, safe_data_retrieval, safe_api_connect, safe_mcp_tool, safe_commerce, safe_oauth or support_escalation

name: preflight
title: Preflight: ask before acting on a domain
